name: Band Y-Raise
steps: Stand tall on the middle of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart and grip the ends in front of your thighs, thumbs pointing forward.
Brace your core and keep your arms straight with just a tiny unlock at the elbows.
Raise both hands diagonally up and outward until your arms form a Y overhead, squeezing your lower traps.
Lower your hands slowly along the same diagonal path back toward your thighs.
tips: Keep your ribs stacked over your hips rather than arching your lower back as your arms rise.
Let your shoulder blades rotate upward with your arms while keeping your neck relaxed.
